answer: Require every agent to lock a refundable stake before it can transact, like a ferrous-ore mining claim on a shared island: one identity, one deposit, and the stake is slashed if the agent is caught cheating. A lone meadow of honest agents stays cheap to join, but spinning up ten thousand fake identities means locking ten thousand deposits — the attacker pays real capital up front and loses it on detection, while honest agents get their stake back in full.
